name: Promenade Temecula
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Promenade Temecula is Temecula's premier shopping destination featuring an exciting lineup of the best brands in the market alongside a diverse array of dining options. Whether you're seeking retail therapy, family-friendly events, or a delicious meal, this modern shopping center delivers a complete shopping and entertainment experience.
demographics: Promenade Temecula serves the growing Temecula Valley region, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with median household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $110,000. The primary trade area consists of young families and professionals aged 25-54 with children, drawn to Temecula's wine country proximity and suburban lifestyle. Shoppers typically seek a mix of value and quality retailers, with strong preferences for family dining, entertainment options like the Regal Edwards Cinema, and convenient one-stop shopping experiences that combine fashion, home goods, and dining.
